== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Under Jabba's Protection (Errata)]], showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published card image shows this text. The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-04-Under_Jabbas_Protection.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-L-underjabbasprotection-pre.gif]]) show the original text.

* '''Text source:''' the Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type, 2012-12-12 capture: https://web.archive.org/web/20121212003733/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html; same text in the capture of 11 January 2013). Icons are drawn as on the printed slips.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “When you play this Interrupt, may place a Rep on your objective in Used Pile. Lose X cards stacked on I Know That Laugh to reduce a weapon or battle destiny total by X. OR Use 1 Force to: take a card stacked on I Know That Laugh in hand (or stack top card of lost pile on it).”
* '''Made:''' 9 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 72): the card's own Virtual Legacy card (GEMP <code>1282_26</code>; printed frame, Decipher art, title, lore, icons and set mark as on the Players Committee card image) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
